statutory.label: entailment
statutory.reasoning: 31 U.S.C. § 5324(a)(3) prohibits structuring transactions to evade reporting. The entity executed seven transactions, including cash deposits under $10,000 and larger ACH transfers, indicating an attempt to fragment activity and avoid the reporting threshold. This satisfies the statutory elements of conducting a transaction in a financial institution, intending to evade reporting, and structuring the flow of funds. Yes it applies because the pattern meets the statutory definition of structuring.
